metadata.title: आदिवासियों का स्वागत और दावत दोनों लाजवाब । Mutton Curry । The Tribal Kitchen | English captions
metadata.description:
This Episode of The Tribal Kitchen will take you to a small village of Jharkhand State in India. We met the people of Oraon and Munda tribes in this village. In this episode Anuranjana, an Oraon woman cooked a fabulaous mutton curry for us in Adivasi style. 

Anchor - Shyam Sunder
